# KiSS Reference Documentations

This folder contains an offline copy of reference documentation of KiSS and FKiSS specification.

# Folders

| Folder                 | Source URL                            | Comments                                                                                                                                                                       |
|------------------------|---------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `www2s.biglobe.ne.jp/` | https://www2s.biglobe.ne.jp/~yav/kiss | By the original author of `fkiss` (a KiSS viewer on UNIX) and inventor of FKiSS (script language for KiSS). Mainly written in Japanese. Include specification of FKiSS v1, v2. |
| `otakuworld.com/`      | https://otakuworld.com/kiss/kisshelp/ | Written in English. Include all specification of FKiSS v1 ~ v4.                                                                                                                |
